statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic f (2 * π) → ∀ (a : ℝ), ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..a + 2 * π, f x = ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x

goal.text: ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..a + 2 * π, f x = ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x
goal.lhs: ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..a + 2 * π, f x

atoms: ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..a + 2 * π, f x

values: fun x => Real.sin x + Real.sin (2 * x) ^ 2
